name: usda-mcp-server
description: Search foods, compare nutrients, and look up the full USDA FoodData Central database via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

USDA_FDC_API_KEY.title: USDA FDC API Key
USDA_FDC_API_KEY.description: API key for the USDA FoodData Central API. Get one free at https://api.data.gov/signup/

USDA_CLAMP_LIMITS.title: Clamp batch size
USDA_CLAMP_LIMITS.description: true: usda_get_foods fetches the first 20 distinct FDC IDs of a larger request and returns the rest as deferredIds. false: it rejects a request with more than 20 IDs.
